# Sage Intacct

Sage Intacct is a cloud financial management platform for accounting, purchasing, billing, cash management, projects, and related business operations.

Category: Finance. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/sage-intacct/.

## Actions

- **Create Attachment**: Upload files and create a Sage Intacct attachment.
- **Create Keyed Object Record**: Create a purchasing transaction definition at a caller-supplied key.
- **Create Object Record**: Create a record in one cataloged Sage Intacct object.
- **Create Security Access Admin Record - Explicit Authorization Required**: Perform explicitly authorized security/access administration by creating a role, user group, or user-group membership.
- **Create Singleton Object**: Create a cataloged Sage Intacct singleton setup object.
- **Delete Object Record**: Delete one record from a cataloged Sage Intacct object.
- **Delete Security Access Admin Record - Explicit Authorization Required**: Perform explicitly authorized destructive security/access administration by deleting a role, user group, or group membership.
- **Download Generated File** (read-only): Generate or download a file from one cataloged Sage Intacct report, export, or PDF operation.
- **Execute Destructive Workflow**: Execute one cataloged irreversible Sage Intacct workflow or consolidation operation.
- **Execute Service Operation**: Execute a cataloged Sage Intacct bulk, WIP, document-sequence, schedule-reallocation, or read-only composite operation.
- **Execute Workflow**: Execute a cataloged Sage Intacct submit, approve, post, renew, hold, resume, release, recall, or reclassification workflow.
- **Get GL Account** (read-only): Get the full General Ledger account identified by its Sage Intacct system-assigned key.
- **Get Object Model** (read-only): List available or type-filtered Sage Intacct object resources, or return the full field, enum, relationship, nullability, and method model…
- **Get Object Record** (read-only): Get one record by key from a cataloged Sage Intacct object.
- **Get Singleton Object** (read-only): Get a cataloged Sage Intacct singleton setup object.
- **List Allowed Operations** (read-only): Check which operations the connected user may perform on specific Sage Intacct records without changing those records.
- **List Dimensions** (read-only): List the company's standard and user-defined accounting dimensions, including General Ledger enablement and each dimension's backing…
- **List Entities** (read-only): Return up to 100 company entities and their exact entity IDs for safely scoping Sage Intacct requests.
- **List GL Accounts** (read-only): Return up to 100 General Ledger account references with the system keys needed to retrieve full account details.
- **List Object Records** (read-only): List records for one cataloged Sage Intacct object.
- **Query Object Records** (read-only): Query one permitted Sage Intacct object with selected fields, filters, sorting, and one page of results.
- **Run Read Service** (read-only): Run a cataloged read-only Sage Intacct status, view, report, or WIP inspection operation selected by its fixed method and path.
- **Update Attachment**: Upload files or metadata to update a Sage Intacct attachment.
- **Update Object Record**: Update one record in a cataloged Sage Intacct object.
- **Update Security Access Admin Record - Explicit Authorization Required**: Perform explicitly authorized security/access administration by updating a role, permission assignment, or user group.
- **Update Singleton Object**: Update a cataloged Sage Intacct singleton setup object.
